title: THE FIRST GAME MADE WITH AI KEABBSTAR (2022...)
author: Upper_Mud_9879
selftext:
I wanted to share a quick side-by-side look at how our character design and visual pipeline for **Kebabstar** have evolved over the last 4 years alongside AI advancements.

From 2022 concepts to 2026 visuals: 4 years of evolving our world-first agentic character pipeline with AI-Tools**!**

Many of gamers were said it is "AI-Slop" but this is not  


KEBABSTAR IS IN EARLY ACCESS ON STEAM.
